sentences.text: Philomena is a 2013 British drama film directed by Stephen Frears , based on the book The Lost Child of Philomena Lee by journalist Martin Sixsmith .	Stephen Frears	Stephen Frears	Martin Sixsmith	Martin Sixsmith	drama film	drama film	Philomena Lee	Philomena Lee

Starring Judi Dench and Steve Coogan , it tells the true story of Philomena Lee 's 50-year search for her forcibly adopted son and Sixsmith 's efforts to help her find him .	Steve Coogan	Steve Coogan	Judi Dench	Judi Dench	Philomena Lee	Philomena Lee
The film was co-produced in the United States and the United Kingdom .	United States	United States	United Kingdom	United Kingdom
It gained critical acclaim and received several international film awards .

Coogan and Jeff Pope won Best Screenplay at the 70th Venice International Film Festival .	Jeff Pope	Jeff Pope	Venice	2013 Venice Film Festival	70th Venice International Film Festival	70th Venice International Film Festival
It was also awarded the People 's Choice Award Runner-Up prize at the 2013 Toronto International Film Festival .	2013 Toronto International Film Festival	2013 Toronto International Film Festival

The film was nominated in four categories at the 86th Academy Awards : Best Picture , Best Adapted Screenplay for Coogan and Pope , Best Actress for Dench , and Best Original Score for Desplat .	86th Academy Awards	86th Academy Awards	Best Picture	Academy Award for Best Picture	Best Adapted Screenplay	Academy Award for Best Adapted Screenplay	Best Actress	Academy Award for Best Actress	Best Original Score	Academy Award for Best Original Score
It was also nominated for four BAFTA Awards and three Golden Globe Awards .	BAFTA Awards	British Academy Film Awards
